title: Vacuum operated gripping element, comprising several specifically shaped sealing elements and vacuum ducts

features.item: A housing with a grip portion designed as a hollow body for gripping
An electrically operated vacuum generating device in the housing
features.quote: Both parts (1,2) are provided with a first bore (3) for the creation of a vacuum and a second bore (4) for the creation of pressure.
features.note: The reference discloses a bore for vacuum creation, implying a vacuum generating device, but does not explicitly state it is electrically operated or located within a housing.

features.item: Exhaust air from the vacuum generating device guided through the hollow grip portion to an air outlet
A sound-damping device arranged in the grip portion
A suction plate with carrier plate and seal extending around the carrier plate
features.quote: The central bore (4) and the outer edge of the device are surrounded by sealing elements (7,8) with integrated w-shaped sealing lips.
features.note: The reference describes sealing elements surrounding the outer edge of the device, which functions as a suction plate, and mentions a metal holding element (carrier plate).
features.refuted: The quote describes sealing elements around a central bore and outer edge, not a seal extending around a carrier plate.

features.item: A grip unit with hollow grip portion, electrically operated vacuum generator, exhaust air routed through grip to outlet, and sound-damping in grip
Grip unit and suction plate combined in a vacuum handling apparatus
features.quote: The device can be connected to a robot arm or similarly working device and is assembled of the suction element (1) made of rubber and a metal holding element (2).
features.note: The reference describes a device assembled from a suction element and a metal holding element, which together form a vacuum handling apparatus.
features.refuted: The quote describes a suction element and holding element connected to a robot arm, but does not mention a 'grip unit' or 'vacuum handling apparatus' as asserted.

features.item: Grip portion at least partially lined with sound-damping material
Vacuum generating device arranged completely in a first housing portion
Sound-reducing device in the first housing portion or first housing portion lined with sound-reducing material
Grip portion elongated between first and second housing portions with air outlet on second housing portion
Air collection screw upstream of grip portion in first housing portion for collecting exhaust air
Bent or curved air baffles downstream of grip portion directing exhaust air to air outlet
Battery coupling point on second housing portion with air baffles directing exhaust air away from battery coupling point
Grip unit and suction plate releasably connected via a coupling device
features.quote: Several semicircular ducts located at the lower surface facilitate a safe connection between suction element (1) and base (2).
features.note: The reference mentions a connection between the suction element and base, but does not explicitly state it is 'releasably connected via a coupling device'.

features.item: Grip unit with suction opening fluidically connected to suction chamber delimited by suction plate
features.quote: Both parts (1,2) are provided with a first bore (3) for the creation of a vacuum and a second bore (4) for the creation of pressure.
features.note: The reference describes bores for vacuum creation, which would be fluidically connected to the suction chamber formed by the suction element and workpiece.
features.refuted: The quote mentions bores for vacuum and pressure creation but does not describe a suction opening connected to a suction chamber delimited by a suction plate.

claims.note: The reference describes a suction gripper for workpieces, not a grip unit for a vacuum hand-operated laying device.
The reference describes a suction element and a metal holding element, but not a housing with a grip portion or an electrically operated vacuum generating device.
The reference does not describe a grip portion designed as a hollow body.
The reference does not describe exhaust air being guided through a grip portion to an air outlet, nor does it mention a vacuum generating device.
The reference describes a vacuum gripping element but does not mention any sound-damping device or grip portion.
The reference does not describe a grip portion or any sound-damping material.
The reference describes a suction element and a metal holding element, but not a housing with a first housing portion for a vacuum generating device.
The reference does not describe a first housing portion or sound-reducing devices/material within it.
This reference describes a suction gripper for workpieces, not a grip unit with a grip portion elongated between first and second housing portions with an air outlet on the second housing portion.
This reference does not disclose an air collection device, an air collection screw, or any arrangement for collecting exhaust air upstream of a grip portion in a first housing portion.
This reference does not describe a grip portion, or bent/curved air baffles for guiding exhaust air to an air outlet.
This reference does not disclose a battery coupling point, an electrical energy storage device, or air baffles for directing exhaust air away from such a point.
The reference describes a suction gripper with vacuum and pressure bores, but there is no mention of air baffles for directing exhaust air away from a battery coupling point.

claims.quote: Suction gripper for sucking and holding workpieces
claims.note: The reference describes a 'Sauggreifer' which translates to 'suction gripper' for sucking and holding workpieces, which is a type of vacuum handling apparatus.

claims.quote: the suction element (1) made of rubber and a metal holding element (2).
claims.note: The reference discloses a suction element (seal) made of rubber and a metal holding element (carrier plate). However, it does not explicitly state that the seal is fastened to the carrier plate and extends around it, although this is implied by the structure of a suction gripper.
This claim refers to 'said grip unit according to claim 1' of the subject invention, which is not present in this reference.

(non-English passage at claim 10) This passage describes a dovetail groove and profile for connecting the suction body holder (grip unit) and suction body (suction plate), which is a releasable connection.

claims.quote: Both parts (1,2) are provided with a first bore (3) for the creation of a vacuum and a second bore (4) for the creation of pressure.
claims.note: This passage describes a bore for creating a vacuum, which functions as a suction opening fluidically connected to a suction chamber to generate a vacuum between the suction element and an object.
claims.refuted: The quote mentions bores for vacuum and pressure but does not teach a suction opening fluidically connected to a suction chamber delimited by a suction plate.

overall.why: The reference describes a vacuum gripping element with a suction body and holder, including sealing elements and bores for vacuum and pressure, which aligns with some core features of the subject invention, but lacks details on the grip portion, sound damping, and specific exhaust air routing.
